# Kivov Digital

> Kivov Digital is a Toronto-based, workflow-first AI consultancy for small and mid-sized businesses. It maps how work actually happens, finds where time is being lost, and builds practical AI and automation systems around the way a team already works, instead of forcing the business into a new platform. Founded by Kim Wong, a former Deloitte and EY consultant with 7+ years in software development, enterprise integrations, cloud architecture and AI. Its 4 services are AI consulting, website management (including WordPress support and local SEO & GEO), AI automation and app development.

Key facts:

- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Calls are free 30-minute video calls.
- Approach: start with the workflow, not the tool. Every engagement begins by understanding one real process; the audit also names what should *not* be automated.
- Prices are public and in CAD:
  - Workflow Fit Check: free, about 3 minutes, eight questions, high-level result.
  - Workflow-First AI Audit: CAD $495 founding-client price for the first five clients (standard CAD $750). One priority workflow → map, bottlenecks, prioritized opportunities, written 30-day action plan, walkthrough. CAD $500 is credited if you hire Kivov for implementation within 30 days.
  - Build With You: CAD $1,250 billed every 4 weeks. Two 45-minute strategy calls a month, custom Claude skills and automations built alongside your team, always-on text support with a 12 business-hour response SLA, documentation hub. 100% money-back guarantee if you're not satisfied with the results.
  - Build For You: CAD $5,500 per project. One workflow taken end-to-end (up to ~two core system integrations): architecture, implementation, testing, exception handling, team handoff, 30-day stabilization. Starts with discovery or a completed audit.
- Contact: hello@kivov.ca · replies within one business day.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kivov.ca/): What Kivov does and who it is for.
- [Services](https://kivov.ca/services/): Kivov's 4 services: AI consulting, website management, AI automation and app development.
- [AI Consulting](https://kivov.ca/services/ai-consulting/): Workflow-first AI consulting in Toronto: map one workflow, find where time is lost, recommend what fits. Starts with the free Workflow Fit Check or the AI Workflow Audit.
- [Website Management](https://kivov.ca/services/website-management/): Website management and maintenance in Toronto for WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, GoDaddy and Webflow sites, plus domain, hosting accounts and Google Business Profile. Quoted after a free call.
- [AI Automation](https://kivov.ca/services/ai-automation/): AI automation for small businesses, built inside the tools they already use. Emails and invoices wait as drafts for approval; anything that runs on its own, like a missed-call text, follows rules the owner approves.
- [App Development](https://kivov.ca/services/app-development/): Web and Android app development in Toronto, built fast with AI, always starting with a discovery session. Quoted after discovery.
- [Use Cases](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/): Specific problems Kivov solves, grouped by service.
- [WordPress Support](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/wordpress-support/): WordPress support in Toronto: fixes, updates, contact forms, tracking and Google listings, plus WordPress website design.
- [Local SEO & GEO](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/local-seo/): Local SEO in Toronto plus GEO (AI SEO): helping Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT understand and recommend a business.
- [Law Firm SEO & GEO](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/law-firm-seo/): SEO and GEO for law firms: website fixes, Google Business Profile, posts and Q&A pages, with the lawyer's wording kept as written.
- [Invoice Automation](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/invoice-automation/): AI reads vendor invoice PDFs of any layout and enters them into QuickBooks or an ERP as drafts for a person to approve.
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/missed-call-text-back/): Missed call text back set up on the business's existing phone number: callers get a text within seconds and can book a time.
- [AI Receptionist](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/ai-receptionist/): An AI voice agent that answers calls, follows the business's booking rules and books into its calendar.
- [AI Follow-Up Emails](https://kivov.ca/use-cases/ai-follow-up-emails/): After every client call, AI drafts the follow-up email in the owner's voice for them to review and send. It never sends on its own.
- [Resources](https://kivov.ca/resources/): Answers to questions small business owners ask about AI automation, GEO and WordPress SEO.
- [Generative engine optimization: how do I get ChatGPT to recommend my business?](https://kivov.ca/resources/generative-engine-optimization/): How ChatGPT picks who to recommend, and what a small business can put on its site so it gets cited.
- [AI automation for small business: what should I automate first?](https://kivov.ca/resources/ai-automation/): Count how often a task happens and what it costs each time; automate the biggest number first.
- [WordPress SEO: why isn't my WordPress site showing up on Google?](https://kivov.ca/resources/wordpress-seo/): Check what Google actually indexed in Search Console; WordPress leftovers like attachment pages often crowd out real pages.
- [AI Packages](https://kivov.ca/ai-packages/): The full service ladder, pricing and FAQ.
- [AI Workflow Audit](https://kivov.ca/audit/): What the audit covers, what it won't do, and how it runs.
- [Free Workflow Fit Check](https://kivov.ca/fit-check/): The free three-minute self-assessment.
- [About Kim Wong](https://kivov.ca/about/): Founder background and why Kivov exists.
- [Book a call](https://kivov.ca/book/): Schedule a Zoom call.
- [Contact](https://kivov.ca/contact/): Send a message.
